title: Degree-Four Vector-Coordinate SoS Cannot Detect the MUB Upper Bound
summary: We prove a degree-four Sum-of-Squares lower bound for the standard vector-coordinate formulations of mutually unbiased bases. For every dimension $d$ and every proposed number $m$ of bases, we construct a degree-four pseudoexpectation satisfying the orthonormality constraints and the cross-unbiasedness constraints in the quartic equality formulation. The construction is expectation over $m$ independent Haar-random orthonormal bases.
